title: May the orchestrator and workers push branches and open PRs?
context: Decision 7 kept push, merge and delete with Matt. Pushing a feature branch and opening a PR is low risk (a PR is easy to close) and was costing Matt busywork. Amends decision 7 on push only; merging and deleting stay with Matt.

options.name: Feature branches and PRs
options.summary: The orchestrator or workers may push feature branches and open PRs. Merging, pushing to main, force-pushing and deleting branches stay with Matt.
pros: A PR is easy to close
cons: Work becomes visible on GitHub without a fresh OK

options.name: Push only when told
options.summary: Push a branch only when Matt says so in chat.

options.name: Keep decision 7 as is
pros: Nothing leaves the machine without Matt

recommendation: Saves the most busywork; merging is the step that matters and it stays with Matt.
reason: Pushing and opening PRs is a task that you or the workers can do

settles.value: agents may push feature branches and open PRs; merge, push to main, force push and branch deletion stay with the human
